$comment: Condition-gated damage perks for the builder's combat conditions (hit location, target range, target type, crippled limbs, V.A.T.S. AP cost, melee swing speed, weapon damage type, Ghoul Glow). Every number is read from the Patch 70 card text in src/data/perk-cards.json; the `source` string quotes the rank-1 card. Fractions add to the same additive base pool as the other perks (post-Patch 22 rule); `exterminator` is an armor-penetration source and goes through the 90 % cap in creation-engine-math instead. Nothing here is verified against a datamine: where the card text is the only source, the entry says so.
source: Patch 70 card texts (src/data/perk-cards.json); https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Fallout_76_combat for the hit-location and range vocabulary

hitLocations.body: Any limb or body shot with no body-part multiplier (×1.00).
hitLocations.torso: Torso shot: ×1.00 body-part multiplier, Center Masochist applies.
hitLocations.weakSpot: Head / weak point: body-part multiplier from src/data/truth/weak-spot.json, weak-spot perks apply.

targetRanges.close: Within the game's 'close enemies' band (Guerrilla, Guerrilla Master). The exact distance is unpublished.
targetRanges.mid: Neither close nor far: no range perk applies. Default.
targetRanges.far: Within the game's 'far enemies' band (Down Ranger). The exact distance is unpublished.

glow.condition: Ghoul only. 'Glow high' = Glow meter at or above highThresholdPct; 'spending Glow' = the Stances toggle combatStance.isSpendingGlow (the cards expend Glow per attack, the rate is unpublished); 'has Glow' = Glow meter above 0.
glow.source: Patch 70 card texts say only 'When your Glow is high' / 'Expend a small amount of Glow' / 'While you have Glow'. The 80 % line is the builder's reading, shared with the vitals sheet (Jaguar Speed) and the Lucid 1★ threshold; no datamine confirms it.

center-masochist.source: Card text (Patch 70): '+25% ranged damage when attacking the torso.' Card text is the only source.

guerrilla.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'You do +10% ranged damage to close enemies.' Card text is the only source.
guerrilla.note: Until 2026-09-28 the engine applied Guerrilla as always-on class damage for automatic pistols (0.1 + rank × 0.05), the same mistake Gunslinger had before the weak-spot state. There are no Expert/Master Guerrilla cards in Patch 70.

guerrilla-master.condition: ranged weapons; target range = close; per Onslaught stack
guerrilla-master.source: Card text (Patch 70): '+5% ranged damage to close enemies per Onslaught stack, +5 max stacks.' Card text is the only source.
guerrilla-master.note: The '+5 max stacks' raises the Onslaught cap; the engine's pre-existing 5-stack cap on this perk is kept unchanged and is not a verified number.

down-ranger.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'You do +10% ranged damage to far enemies.' Card text is the only source (the unification plan's '+10/20 %' was a two-rank misread; the card has three ranks).

glow-sight.condition: any weapon; target is a Glowing enemy
glow-sight.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'Deal +20% damage to Glowing Enemies.' Card text is the only source.

exterminator.unit: percent of the target's armor ignored
exterminator.condition: any weapon; target is an insect; capped with every other penetration source at 90 % by creation-engine-math
exterminator.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'Your attacks ignore 25% armor of any insect.' Card text is the only source.

easy-target.condition: ranged weapons; target has at least one crippled limb
easy-target.source: Card text (Patch 70): '+25% ranged damage to crippled targets.' Card text is the only source.

tormentor.condition: any weapon (the card names no weapon class); per crippled limb, no cap stated on the card (the switchboard allows at most 4 limbs)
tormentor.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'You deal 20% more damage per crippled limb your target has.' Card text is the only source.

shotgun-champ.condition: target has at least one crippled limb; multiplied by the weapon's projectile count
shotgun-champ.source: Card text (Patch 70): '+10% damage to crippled targets per projectile your weapon fires.' Card text is the only source.
shotgun-champ.note: combat-firepower-catalog.ts has no projectile counts yet. Weapons of the shotgunner class are assumed to fire 8 projectiles (fallout.wiki lists 8 for the combat, pump-action and double-barrel shotguns; not verified per weapon). Other weapons get no bonus until the catalog carries a `projectiles` field for them.

number-cruncher.unit: point of the weapon's V.A.T.S. AP cost per shot
number-cruncher.condition: any weapon; uses the resolved AP cost per shot (base × attachments × V.A.T.S. Optimized), so a cheaper V.A.T.S. shot also lowers this bonus
number-cruncher.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'Your weapons have 2% increased damage per AP cost.' Card text is the only source.

martial-artist.condition: melee and unarmed weapons; multiplies the swing rate before the Patch 70 +100 % swing-speed cap (2.0×)
martial-artist.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'Your melee weapons weigh 20% less, and you can swing them 10% faster.' Card text is the only source; the weight part is a carry-weight effect and is not modelled here.
martial-artist.note: Unarmed weapons (gauntlets, knuckles) are melee weapons in the game's weapon classes, so the catalog's 'unarmed' class gets the bonus too.

tightly-wound.condition: heavy guns that spin up (Gatling family, minigun); the catalog has no spin-up flag, so the line is shown for every heavy gun
tightly-wound.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'Weapons spin up 60% faster.' Card text is the only source. The Patch 70 card has one rank; the unification plan's '+30/60 %' was a two-rank misread.
tightly-wound.note: The engine has no spin-up model (fire rate is steady-state), so this is a breakdown line only and touches no number.

pyro-technician.condition: weapon whose primary damage type is fire (Flamer, Holy Fire, Cremator); scales with live Intelligence; values between the published rows are interpolated linearly, INT is clamped to 1..100
pyro-technician.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'Increase fire damage based on your INT.' Scaling rows from https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Pyro-Technician (INT 1 → 5.00 %, 5 → 9.86 %, 10 → 15.92 %, 20 → 26.33 %, 30 → 35.00 %, 40 → 38.33 %, 50 → 41.67 %, 60 → 45.00 %, 70 → 46.25 %, 80 → 47.50 %, 90 → 48.75 %, 100 → 50.00 %, cap 50 %); the formula behind the rows is unpublished.
pyro-technician.note: Only the primary damage type is scaled: the engine carries one damage number per weapon, so a weapon whose secondary damage is fire (Shishkebab) gets a breakdown note and no number. The pre-rework card ('Science Expert', 5/10 % energy damage) is unrelated.

cryologist.condition: weapon whose primary damage type is cryo; scales with live Intelligence; values between the published rows are interpolated linearly, INT is clamped to 1..100
cryologist.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'Increase cryo damage based on your INT.' Scaling rows from https://fallout.wiki/wiki/Cryologist (the same INT 1 → 5.00 % … 100 → 50.00 % table as Pyro-Technician, cap 50 %); the formula behind the rows is unpublished.
cryologist.note: No catalog weapon has cryo as its primary damage type yet (the Cold Shoulder's cryo is its secondary damage), so today this card only produces the 'secondary cryo not modelled' note; the number is ready for a Cryolator row.

glowing-criticals.condition: Ghoul; Glow high (see `glow`); V.A.T.S. critical damage, added to the crit bonus pool like Better Criticals
glowing-criticals.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'When your Glow is high, Gain 20% bonus Critical damage in V.A.T.S.' Card text is the only source.

mad-scientist.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'Energy Weapons expend a small amount of Glow per attack for +10% Damage.' Card text is the only source (the unification plan's '+10/20 %' skipped the 15 % middle rank).

radiation-power.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'Expend a small amount of Glow per hit to deal 10% bonus damage to targets.' Card text is the only source (the plan's '+10/20 %' skipped the 15 % middle rank).

radioactive-strength.condition: Ghoul; spending Glow; power attack (the Stances 'Power Attack' toggle). Bashing is not an attack mode in the engine, so the bash half of the card is not modelled.
radioactive-strength.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'Expend a Moderate amount of Glow to deal 50% more damage with Power Attacks & Bashing.' Card text is the only source.

science-monster.condition: Ghoul; Glow above 0; hit in the last 10 s (the Stances 'Hit in last 10 s' toggle, combatStance.wasHitRecently); any weapon
science-monster.source: Card text (Patch 70): 'While you have Glow, gain 5% bonus damage for 10 seconds upon getting hit.' Card text is the only source (the plan's '+5/15 %' skipped the 10 % middle rank).
science-monster.note: The engine has no combat timeline, so 'upon getting hit' is a manual toggle rather than a timer.
